test.create_query: CREATE TABLE map_contains_key_like_subcolumn_perf ( id UInt64, m Map(String, String) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0
CREATE TABLE map_contains_value_like_subcolumn_perf ( id UInt64, m Map(String, String) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO map_contains_key_like_subcolumn_perf SELECT number AS id, mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> if(i = 15, 'target_key', concat('k', toString(i))), range(16)), arrayMap(i -> concat( hex(cityHash64(number, i, 1)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 2)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 3)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 4))), range(16))) AS m FROM numbers_mt(250000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE map_contains_key_like_subcolumn_perf FINAL SETTINGS mutations_sync = 1

INSERT INTO map_contains_value_like_subcolumn_perf SELECT number AS id, mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> concat( hex(cityHash64(number, i, 1)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 2)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 3)), hex(cityHash64(number, i, 4))), range(16)), arrayMap(i -> if(i = 15, 'target_value', concat('v', toString(i))), range(16))) AS m FROM numbers_mt(250000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE map_contains_value_like_subcolumn_perf FINAL SETTINGS mutations_sync = 1
